name: offroad-4w v1: 2-seat electric off-road vehicle, ladder frame, rear drive, right-hand drive

occupant_mass.basis: Q33: AIST anthropometric database 1991-92 item N1 Weight, young adult male 95th percentile (the README lists it as not checked)

battery_voltage.basis: 16 x 3.2 V: cell nominal voltage, EVE LF50K product specification LF50K-73103 Ver. D, section 3 (checked 2026-11-03); 16 in series is HIRAKU's choice

air_density.basis: ICAO standard atmosphere (ICAO Doc 7488), sea level (not checked)

fatigue_slope.basis: IIW form: A. F. Hobbacher, Recommendations for Fatigue Design of Welded Joints and Components, 2nd ed., Springer 2016 (not checked)

fatigue_knee_cycles.basis: IIW form: A. F. Hobbacher, Recommendations for Fatigue Design of Welded Joints and Components, 2nd ed., Springer 2016 (not checked)

tyre_stiffness.basis: 60 N/mm, range 45 to 90 N/mm: HIRAKU's judgement from three sources on ATV-class tyres (not measurements of this vehicle's tyre), read 2026-11-06 via web.archive.org copies: (1) D. R. Krueger, Investigation of Lateral Performance of an ATV Tire on Natural, Deformable Surfaces, MS thesis, Auburn University, 2007, Appendix B, Fig. 6.4: Dunlop KT 821 22x8-10 measured statically at 0.69 / 1.03 / 1.38 bar, about 57 / 62 / 74 N/mm read off the figure; (2) BKT technical data sheets, Sierra Max Pro AT 25x8 R12 and Sierra Max AT 25x10 R12: from the rated load and the static loaded radius HIRAKU computes the mean stiffness from 0 to the rated load, 54.3 and 71.7 N/mm (the sheets give no pressure for the loaded radius; such a secant is below the tangent); (3) G. N. Wilson, Towards Speed Selection for High-Speed Operation of Autonomous Ground Vehicles on Rough Off-Road Terrains, PhD thesis, University of Calgary, 2018, Appendix B.3.5.1: ATV 16x8-7 at about 0.69 bar, 36 to 44 N/mm static and 0.1-10 Hz dynamic (dynamic / static about 1.0-1.2)

battery_max_temperature.basis: cell limit, EVE LF50K product specification, section 3 (checked)

controller_max_temperature.basis: Curtis 1234/36/38 manual, Appendix D Table D-1 (checked)

motor_max_temperature.basis: assumption: insulation class F of IEC 60085 (not checked)
